quote.translation: A case of this kind would be digging a hole in order to plant a tree and finding treasure coming up out of the ground.

regions.text: この例はアリストテレスが「形而上學第五篇（Aristoteles,Metaphysica,A.80,1025）に舉げ、後、

quote.translation: Aristotle gives this example in Book V of the Metaphysics (Aristoteles, Metaphysica, Δ 30, 1025a), and Boethius later commented on it (Boethius, De interpretatione, Ed.
III. Migne p. 491, 506), and ever since it has often been cited as an example of chance.

regions.text: ,Ed.T.iib.I.Mignep$91,86）が解說して以來、偶然の例として屡々暴げ.ちれるものである。

quote.translation: Planting the tree was the purpose, and obtaining treasure was not included in that purpose, which is why we call the finding of the treasure chance.

regions.text: 樹木を植ゑることが目前で、寶を得ることば目の中に含まれてあなかつたから寶を得たことを偶然どいふので、ある。/一方に、植木屋が地を掘つて樹木を植ゑる行動の系列と他方に、盗賊か何かが地中に寶を際匿した行動の系列とがあつて、その各々獨立した雨系列間に目的性以外の何等か積極約な開係が立てられたのである。

quote.translation: On the one side there is the series of actions in which the gardener digs the ground and plants the tree, and on the other the series of actions in which a thief, or someone of the kind, hid treasure in the ground, and between these two series, each independent of the other, some positive relation other than purposiveness has been established.

regions.text: また例へば十七世紀の化學者プランドが鎌金術に従つ世銀を金に選へる物質を得ようとして尿を蒸發し強熱した結果、光を後する元素を得たことを彼が燐を偶然に登見したといふ。

quote.translation: Or again, we say that Brand, the seventeenth-century chemist, discovered phosphorus by chance when, trying in the manner of alchemy to obtain a substance that would turn silver into gold, he evaporated urine, heated the residue strongly and obtained as a result an element that gives off light.

regions.text: この場合に偶然といふのも燐を得ることが目のうちに含まれてゐなかつたからでおる。

quote.translation: Here too we speak of chance because obtaining phosphorus was not included in the purpose.

regions.text: この場合も、一方に鎌金術的意岡の質行として行動の系列があり他方に燐酸盟から燐が遊離した化學的系列がある。きうしてこの雨系列間に目的性でない他の開係が積極に立てられたのである。

quote.translation: In this case, too, there is on the one side a series of actions carrying out an alchemical design and on the other a chemical series in which phosphorus was liberated from phosphate, and between these two series a relation of another kind, one that is not purposiveness, has been positively established.
